ℹ Set `.check_share_source = FALSE` to calculate `share_of_parent()` and `share_of_total()` from sources you have established yourself, or explicitly collect the data before calling `summarize_with_margins()`.
ℹ Collection changes the default of `.check_margin_label` from `FALSE` to `TRUE`; set it explicitly when re-running this call.
